I didn't need to delete any layers: Ultralytics has a built-in `embed` option for this. `model.embed(source)` returns feature vectors from an intermediate layer. By default that's the second-to-last layer. You can also pass `embed=[layer_indices]` to `predict()` to choose other layers. The vectors are pooled and flattened per image, so you can compare them directly, for example with cosine similarity.

The `IndexError` happens because removing the last layer takes out the Detect head. The predictor's NMS step then receives raw feature maps instead of detections.
